description: Personal portfolio of Gershon Adjei Otinkorang — Cloud, Network & Software Engineering.
//browserslist: Modern target so Next/SWC stops shipping polyfills for Array.prototype.at, Object.hasOwn, String.prototype.trimStart and similar Baseline-2022 features (~14KB of dead JS on the critical path). These browser versions all support them natively; the coverage query keeps real-world reach wide while excluding the ancient engines that forced the transpile.
//overrides: Pin patched transitive deps. typescript is capped to 5.x because a loose transitive range (>=3.3.1) let a clean install resolve TypeScript 7, whose native rewrite drops the compiler API next build needs. NOTE: do NOT blanket-override brace-expansion — it ships multiple major lines and ESLint's minimatch@3 needs the 1.x line, so forcing 5.x crashes ESLint (expand is not a function). Its advisory is dev-only and excluded by `npm audit --omit=dev`.
